request.message:
In this document's 'Archive' table, the data rows must end up being EXACTLY these 7 rows, in exactly this order, top to bottom. Keep the table's header row and all of its formatting. Cells shown in quotes are literal - copy them exactly. Cells described in angle brackets are for you to write.
  The rows, top to bottom, must be exactly: 'Week 13', 'Week 12', 'Week 11', 'Week 10', 'Week 9', 'Weeks 5-8 (rolled up)', 'Weeks 1-4 (rolled up)'.
  The first cell of each of those rows must read exactly as quoted, INCLUDING the word 'Week' - write 'Week 3', never '3'. The column is headed 'Week'; that heading is not a substitute for the label.
  Row 'Week 13' is NEW. Its Dates cell is '2026-03-30 to 2026-04-05'. Its Shipped cell is your own summary, at most 20 words, of EXACTLY this text and nothing else in the document: "Localisation pipeline stubbed for 6 languages; Vertical slice level greyboxed and playable start to finish; Combat prototype merged to main behind a feature flag; Enemy AI flocking behaviour landed for Scrapper swarms". Its Risks carried cell is your own summary, at most 15 words, of exactly these risks: "Crash rate above the cert threshold; Publisher marketing beats not aligned with content lock; Matchmaking backend untested above 5k CCU". Summarise the quoted text only - other steps in this instruction change the document, and this row must describe Week 13, not the week replacing it.
  Row 'Weeks 5-8 (rolled up)' is NEW and REPLACES the rows 'Week 8', 'Week 7', 'Week 6', 'Week 5'. Its Dates cell is '2026-02-02 to 2026-03-01'. Its Shipped cell is one sentence of at most 25 words summarising those 4 rows together. Its Risks carried cell is at most 10 words. Delete those rows.
  Every other row keeps its existing cell contents exactly as they are - do not rewrite, reword or re-summarise them.

Change NOTHING else in the document. Do not touch the status line, the 'What changed' list, the 'What is at risk' table or the 'What is next' list.
REPLACEMENT MEANS REPLACEMENT: where this instruction lists what a section must contain, the section must end up containing exactly that and nothing else. Delete what is not on the list rather than keeping it alongside.
Preserve all existing formatting exactly: the document title, every section heading, table borders, header-row shading, alternating row colours, fonts, font sizes and colours. Do not restyle anything. Do not add, remove or rename any heading. Do not reorder the sections.
Copy every quoted or listed value character for character. Do not add a full stop to a bullet that has none, and do not reword anything.
STRUCTURAL RULE: both tables must remain <table> elements with their header rows intact. Never replace a table with a single row, a div or a list. Never drop a table's header row.
request.document_html:
Nebula Drift - Weekly Production Digest

Week 13 · 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-05 · Phase: Vertical Slice
Vantage Nine Studios · internal · standing document, edited in place every Monday

What changed

  • Localisation pipeline stubbed for 6 languages
  • Vertical slice level greyboxed and playable start to finish
  • Combat prototype merged to main behind a feature flag
  • Enemy AI flocking behaviour landed for Scrapper swarms

What is at risk

RiskOwnerArea SeverityTrend
Crash rate above the cert thresholdDev H.QAMediumworsening
Publisher marketing beats not aligned with content lockMarcus O.ProductionLowworsening
Matchmaking backend untested above 5k CCUYuki T.BackendCriticalworsening

What is next

  • Instrument the traversal funnel
  • Close the audio licence

Archive

Newest first. Detail rows older than 8 weeks are folded into a single rolled-up row so this section stays readable at 52 weeks.

Week Dates Shipped Risks carried
Week 12 2026-03-23 to 2026-03-29 Audio spike finished; Wwise selected; grapple cooldown retuned; camera rig handed off; localisation stubbed Crash rate above threshold; publisher marketing beats misaligned; matchmaking backend untested
Week 11 2026-03-16 to 2026-03-22 Combat prototype merged; Enemy AI flocking landed; eight-player external playtest; audio spike finished; Wwise selected over FMOD Crash rate above cert threshold; publisher marketing beats not aligned; Drift Belt streaming budget overrun
Week 10 2026-03-09 to 2026-03-15 Cinematic camera rig handed off, localisation pipeline stubbed for 6 languages, and the vertical slice was playable. Crash threshold, marketing beats, and streaming budget remain risky.
Week 9 2026-03-02 to 2026-03-08 First playtest with eight external players; audio middleware chose Wwise over FMOD; grapple cooldown retuned. Crash threshold, subtitle sign-off, marketing alignment, and streaming budget remain risky.
Week 8 2026-02-23 to 2026-03-01 Vertical slice greyboxed and playable; combat prototype merged behind a feature flag Crash rate above cert threshold; subtitle sizing lacks accessibility sign-off
Week 7 2026-02-16 to 2026-02-22 Grapple cooldown retuned, camera rig handed off, localisation stubbed for six languages, slice playable start to finish Controller boss tuning, save-game versioning, matchmaking above 5k CCU, second designer delay
Week 6 2026-02-09 to 2026-02-15 Engine 5.4 merged; build times down 31%; art style narrowed to two directions; Drift Belt nav-mesh; Salvage spreadsheet first pass. Boss difficulty untuned for controller; save-game format still unversioned.
Week 5 2026-02-02 to 2026-02-08 Audio depot migrated to Git LFS; Grapple traversal prototype playable end to end on test level Boss encounter difficulty untuned for controller; outsourced character art slipping two weeks.
Weeks 1-4 (rolled up) 2026-01-05 to 2026-02-01 Art direction narrowed, engine upgrade merged, build times improved, and nav-mesh work progressed. Versioning, controller boss tuning, and art delivery remain risky.

hint.suggested_action: Submit document-scale generations via POST /v1/chat/async (chat_async): it returns a job_id immediately, has no gateway ceiling, and reports progress via get_job.
